description: 1971-war veteran MiG-21FL C734 (ex-MOFTU) pole-mounted in an enclosure on the west (IAF) side of Guwahati airfield. Source warbirds.in (2016), bharat-rakshak (memorial at Guwahati, pole mounted).

Unidentified Gnat airframe tucked in the southern corner of Guwahati airfield south of the runway, apparently fitted with a MiG-21FL canopy; seen from the air 2016. Source warbirds.in (R Paul via Dipalay Dey).
Second MiG-21FL (C1157) listed by the bharat-rakshak database as preserved at Guwahati AFS, in addition to pole-mounted C734. Not independently verified.
HS 748 H1178 (ex-Dundigal, populated Jan 2005) recorded by bharat-rakshak as preserved at Air Force Station Guwahati as an 'AWACS mock-up' (a 748 with a dummy rotodome). Not independently verified.
